acip: ,SHES PAR BYED TSUL NI, MA RIG PA'I RAB RIB KYIS GNOD PA BYAS PA STE BLO BSLAD PAS DE KHO NA NYID MA MTHONG BA RNAMS KYIS, PHUNG PO DANG KHAMS DANG SKYE MCHED LA SOGS PA'I RANG GI NGO BO DMIGS PA NI, PHUNG SOGS DE DAG GI NGO BO KUN RDZOB PA STE RAB RIB CAN GYIS SKRA SHAD DMIGS PA LTA BU'O,,
english: And just how should we accomplish this understanding? Those who are being hurt by the cataracts of misunderstanding—those whose minds are infected—cannot see the real nature of things: their suchness. When they look upon the nature of the parts of a person; and the categories of things; and the doors of sense and all of the like, they see the nature of these things that deceives. They are just like those people with cataracts, who perceive a strand of hair.
